text.en: A substantial majority of pet owners praise the quality of dog haircuts and feline grooming. Clients report clean styling, neat nail trims, and fresh-smelling coats. However, one owner reported an accidental cut and an overly close shave contrary to their styling request.

title.en: Helpful Stylists with Front Desk Notes

text.en: Most reviewers describe the groomers as friendly, caring, and skilled, singling out individual stylists for their gentle demeanor. At the same time, feedback is mixed due to an encounter where a customer felt pressured regarding vaccines and experienced indifferent desk service.

title.en: Gentle Handling for Dogs and Cats

text.en: Clients consistently appreciate how comfortably pets are handled, especially cats and anxious dogs. Multiple feline owners emphasize how difficult grooming cats can be and express gratitude that their pets remained calm, relaxed, and secure throughout the grooming process.

q.en: Does the salon groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers highlight successful cat grooming visits, noting that stylists handle both first-time and experienced felines gently.

q.en: How does the team handle nervous or fearful animals?

a.en: Pet owners mention that the staff is very accommodating with anxious dogs, creating a calm environment to make the grooming session as easy as possible.

q.en: Can the salon assist with flea treatments or medication?

a.en: Yes, a client noted that staff accommodated a last-minute appointment to wash and treat cats with prescribed flea medication.

q.en: What should pet owners keep in mind regarding turnaround time?

a.en: While several visits are completed promptly, one customer experienced delays where grooming took up to six hours, indicating occasional schedule congestion.
